reason: Any CI-fixture merchant identity string found in src/ means the fictional fixture shop leaked into the storefront code. Store data (name, tagline, contact domain, address) comes from the backend's StoreProfile; one committed to source breaks that silently, and it must never be Mimora's data either. Matching is case-insensitive and Arabic is compared with diacritics (U+064B-U+0652) and tatweel stripped. Derived from the CI fixture shop "Sukkar & Qamar" (mimora-staff/scripts/fixtures/stores/ci-gift-shop.mjs), the only fixture merchant. Fixture-merchant identity changes here with it.
